name: Puntuación de Legibilidad
description: Mide legibilidad consistency a través de content segments.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform legibilidad levels
mechanism: Divides content into segments and mide complexity varianza. AI text maintains consistent legibilidad throughout, unlike escritura humana que naturally varies.
source: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Ippolito et al. (2020) - Automatic Detection of Generated Text, ACL
Gehrmann, S. et al. (2019). GLTR: Statistical Detection and Visualization of Generated Text. ACL Demo.
Dugan, L. et al. (2023). Real or Fake Text?: Investigating Human Ability to Detect Boundaries Between Human-Written and Machine-Generated Text. AAAI.
